sources.note: Nothing for Roinji. Sec. 5.1 (p.62) only says 'The Roinji language is spoken in the villages of Roinji and Gali near the mouth of the Yupna River'; fn.7 gives 27% shared vocabulary with Gedaged. The typological section 6.1 Phonology compares one Papuan language per family (Saep, Suroi, Kolom, Sinsauru, Rawa, Kewieng, Uruwa, Wantoat, Uri); its only stress sentence (p.~66) is 'Stress is phonemic in Rawa but probably sub-phonemic in Yupna and Wantoat' - Papuan languages, not Roinji. ANU Open Research hdl 1885/254286.
